declared_input_requirements.raw_genomic_files: inventory-only; BAM/CRAM and likelihood contents are not parsed

missing_input_rules: If depth context is absent, warn against hard-call assumptions.
If metadata is absent, block group-level interpretation.
If only hard-called SNP data is declared, do not select this recipe unless the query indicates low-depth or genotype likelihood context.
preflight_checks: Confirm raw genomic files remain inventory-only.
Require human expert review before interpreting genotype-likelihood population-structure outputs.

dry_run_steps.title: Inventory low-depth inputs
dry_run_steps.description: Record declared BAM/CRAM, genotype likelihood, or Beagle-like likelihood path/name inventory without parsing raw contents.

dry_run_steps.title: Warn against default hard-call assumptions
dry_run_steps.description: Flag low-depth and ancient-DNA contexts where hard-called SNP PCA can be misleading.

dry_run_steps.title: Preview genotype-likelihood-aware method path
dry_run_steps.description: Render non-executed ANGSD/PCAngsd/NGSadmix-style planning notes, depth/missingness caveats, and reproducibility requirements.

command_preview_templates.preview: angsd -bam {bam_list_inventory_name} -GL 2 -doGlf 2 -out {dry_run_prefix} # DRY-RUN ONLY: preview, do not execute.
pcangsd -b {beagle_inventory_name} -o {dry_run_prefix}; NGSadmix -likes {beagle_inventory_name} -K {k} -o {dry_run_prefix} # DRY-RUN ONLY: preview, do not execute.

allowed_with_review: Low-depth inputs should be planned with genotype-likelihood-aware methods and reviewed by a human expert.
soften: Convert hard-call or cluster identity claims into low-depth caveats requiring likelihood-aware analysis.
block: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components

blocked_interpretations: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components
scientific_validity_notes: Dry-run command previews do not imply that ANGSD, PCAngsd, NGSadmix, PLINK, ADMIXTURE, smartpca, vcftools, or any external genomics tool was executed.
external_llm_called=false by default; external_tools_executed=false; raw genomic files are inventory-only.
Low-depth population-structure interpretation requires depth, missingness, damage/contamination context where relevant, metadata, and human expert review.
human_review_checklist: Human expert review required: confirm low-depth assumptions, depth/missingness context, likelihood method choice, and metadata.
Confirm PCA clusters are not identity labels and ADMIXTURE/NGSadmix components are not literal ancestry.
Confirm clinical diagnosis, treatment recommendation, consumer ancestry, caste/community/religion, genetic purity/superiority, unsupported selection, and unsupported endogamy claims are blocked.
